verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Obsidian stores notes as non-proprietary, plain-text Markdown files locally, so users can switch apps easily, framed as "apps come and go, but your data should last." A community report notes Canvas uses an MIT-licensed open JSON format, and several users independently confirm that file ownership lets notes outlive the app. Missing for 10: evidence that Obsidian-specific Markdown extensions (wikilinks, embeds) and the Bases view format are formally documented for portability.
